part_b.checked: Kentucky Department of Education. Official procedural safeguards notice for IDEA Part B special education (ages 3-21). Available in multiple languages.

part_c.name: KEIS Family Rights Handbook
part_c.checked: Kentucky Cabinet for Health and Family Services. Comprehensive family rights handbook for Kentucky's Early Intervention System (KEIS/First Steps), Part C program, ages birth-3.

parent_center.name: Kentucky Special Parent Involvement Network (KY-SPIN)
parent_center.checked: Verified via parentcenterhub.org. Located at 10301-B Deering Road, Louisville, KY 40272. Phone: (800) 525-7746 or (502) 937-6894.

note: Kentucky's Part C program is called First Steps (KEIS - Kentucky Early Intervention System) and is administered by Cabinet for Health and Family Services, Department for Public Health. Procedural safeguards also codified in 902 KAR 30:180.
